svg.title: Two pins joined in copper: under the mask with a dam, vs bare copper between
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan views of four leads of a 0.5 mm-pitch part after soldering; the middle two are meant to be connected. Left, marked right: they are joined by copper under the solder mask, with a mask dam between their pads, so each has its own normal joint. Right, marked wrong: the copper between the two pads is left bare, so solder runs across it and the pair looks like a solder bridge.

g.text: ✓ Joined under the mask, with a dam
Solder runs across: it looks like a bridge
